name: glass_cloud_agent_sidebar_ci_status
what: When enabled on Glass, cloud-agent sidebar rows with open/draft PRs subscribe to Origin CI snapshots and show a CI checks ring (BNl) in the trailing PR affordance instead of lifecycle icon only; default off skips CI fetch entirely.

name: glass_create_dialog_cloud_picker
what: When enabled via ma(SGg) in CreateProjectDialog, the Glass new-project dialog loads Origin cloud projects, resolves cloud submit targets (vGg/bGg), and gates the Create button on cloud repo matching; default off uses local target selection only.

name: glass_disable_eager_indexing_for_local_sessions
what: When enabled for local Glass agent workspaces, workbench passes disableGlassLocalSessionEagerIndexing in ext-host init; extensionHostProcess Rct then forces shouldIndex() false, suppressing cursor-retrieval codebase indexing for that session; default off preserves user indexing preference.

name: glass_pdf_file_tab_preview
what: When enabled via ue1/XAi gate helpers, Glass file tabs route application/pdf files to inline pdf.js preview (GlassPdfPreview) instead of the normal text/binary editor path; default off keeps standard editor handling for PDFs.
